originalTitle: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report following IPO
summary: Cerebras Systems reported better-than-expected second-quarter revenue and raised its full-year guidance.
content:
Cerebras Systems raised its full-year guidance in the second earnings report following the chipmaker's initial public offering in May. But the stock tumbled about 14% in extended trading.

Here's how it did in the second quarter versus LSEG consensus estimates:

Cerebras said in a statement on Wednesday that it expects core revenue of between $214 million and $216 million this quarter.

The company raised its full-year outlook and now expects core revenue of between $880 million and $890 million, up from a prior range of $855 million to $865 million.

The $180 million sales figure for the second quarter represents total revenue. Cerebras also reported a core revenue figure of $210 million, which includes "pass-through revenue."

The company recorded a net loss of $450.5 million, after finishing with a profit of $309.5 million, or $1.91 per share, a year earlier. Most of the loss is tied to stock-compensation costs of $386.6 million.

Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman said in an interview that AI demand is "through the roof" and that companies are paying up for its specialty inference chips.

Cerebras is challenging AI chip leader Nvidia for some AI tasks, especially those that need "low latency," or quick responses for interactivity. The company calls it "fast inference." The company said its core gross margin will expand to between 38% and 40% in the current quarter, addressing a concern for investors.

"Gross margins are are in a good spot, and growing, because fast inference is priced at a premium," Feldman said in an interview, adding that Cerebras was able to increase the AI output of its systems.

Cerebras went public on the Nasdaq in May, capitalizing on investor interest in semiconductors that can run AI models. It priced its offering at $185 and raised $6.4 billion in the offering. The stock peaked in May and has fallen since, but closed on Wednesday at $262.06, up 42% from its IPO.

The chipmaker has $25.4 billion in remaining performance obligations, which it said was a sign of "extraordinary future demand." Feldman said that as Cerebras grows, it will benefit from larger scale. The company also said it expects revenue to triple in the next fiscal year.

"We will manufacture more efficiently. We'll get better pricing on componentry. We'll amortize our manufacturing organization over more units," Feldman said. "All of those point up and to the right."

In recent weeks, Cerebras announced a partnership with Nvidia rival Advanced Micro Devices , with products going into production later this year, and said that OpenAI can use its chips to serve its latest model, GPT 5.6 Sol. Cerebras also offers access to its chips through its cloud, which reported $126 million in revenue during the June quarter.

chineseTitle: Cerebras 首次公开募股后发布第二份财报后股价暴跌 14%
chineseSummary: Cerebras Systems 报告第二季度收入好于预期，并上调了全年指引。
chineseContent:
Cerebras Systems 在芯片制造商 5 月份首次公开募股后的第二份收益报告中上调了全年指引。但该股在盘后交易中下跌了约 14%。

以下是第二季度的表现与伦敦证券交易所集团一致预期的比较：

Cerebras 在周三的一份声明中表示，预计本季度核心收入在 2.14 亿美元至 2.16 亿美元之间。

该公司上调了全年预期，目前预计核心收入在 8.8 亿美元至 8.9 亿美元之间，高于之前的 8.55 亿美元至 8.65 亿美元区间。

第二季度 1.8 亿美元的销售额代表总收入。 Cerebras 还公布了 2.1 亿美元的核心收入数据，其中包括“转手收入”。

该公司去年同期净利润为 3.095 亿美元，即每股 1.91 美元，但净亏损为 4.505 亿美元。大部分损失与 3.866 亿美元的股票补偿成本有关。

Cerebras 首席执行官安德鲁·费尔德曼 (Andrew Feldman) 在接受采访时表示，人工智能需求“激增”，各公司正在为其专业推理芯片付费。

Cerebras 在某些人工智能任务上正在向人工智能芯片领导者英伟达发起挑战，特别是那些需要“低延迟”或快速响应交互的任务。该公司称之为“快速推理”。该公司表示，本季度核心毛利率将扩大至 38% 至 40%，解决了投资者的担忧。

费尔德曼在接受采访时表示：“毛利率处于良好状态，并且还在增长，因为快速推理的定价很高。”他补充说，Cerebras 能够增加其系统的人工智能输出。

Cerebras 于 5 月在纳斯达克上市，利用了投资者对可以运行人工智能模型的半导体的兴趣。其发行定价为 185 美元，筹集了 64 亿美元。该股在 5 月份达到顶峰，此后一直下跌，但周三收于 262.06 美元，较 IPO 上涨 42%。

该芯片制造商还有 254 亿美元的剩余履约义务，据称这是“未来需求非凡”的迹象。 Feldman 表示，随着 Cerebras 的发展，它将受益于规模的扩大。该公司还表示，预计下一财年的收入将增加两倍。

“我们将更高效地制造。我们将获得更好的零部件定价。我们将通过更多单位摊销我们的制造组织，”费尔德曼说。 “所有这些都指向上方和右侧。”

最近几周，Cerebras 宣布与 Nvidia 竞争对手 Advanced Micro Devices 建立合作伙伴关系，产品将于今年晚些时候投入生产，并表示 OpenAI 可以使用其芯片为其最新型号 GPT 5.6 Sol 提供服务。 Cerebras 还通过其云提供对其芯片的访问，该云在 6 月份季度的收入为 1.26 亿美元。
